https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: Candidate Bola Ahmed Tinubu is formidable enough without the presidential halo. Wole Olaoye is a Public Relations consultant and veteran journalist. He can be reached on [email protected] , Twitter: @wole_olaoye; Instagram: woleola20
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 总统候选人Bola Ahmed Tinubu无需总统光环加持，已经足够令人敬畏。Wole Olaoye是一名公共关系顾问和资深记者。可通过[电子邮箱]、推特：@wole_olaoye；Instagram：woleola20与他联系。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: Candidate Bola Ahmed Tinubu is formidable enough without the presidential halo. Now, with all presidential powers at his command, he has to be considered a frontrunner in the forthcoming elections. But there are headwinds signalling the fact that although he is redoubtable, he is not unbeatable. The problem with many of his opponents over the years is that they took him for granted. Part of that mindset is demonstrated when the opposition relies on rehashed stories of Tinubu’s failings to sway the electorate, instead of presenting alternative programmes to some of his manifestly unpopular policies. The way things stand at the moment, none of the other presidential candidates has enough gravitas to unseat Tinubu. The ruling APC is the only party that has unveiled its campaign structure and rolled out its vote-catching machine. All the opposition parties have barely 83 days to overtake the current order. Where the game will begin to appear interesting is if, as I argue later in this piece, Atiku Abubakar of the ADC and Peter Obi of the NDC team up to present what Anti-Tinubu elements have described as a dream ticket. In 2023, the opposition vote was split among the PDP, Labour Party (LP), and NNPP. A unified ticket between Obi and Atiku could pool their substantial voting bases — bringing together Obi’s strong momentum in the South-East, South-South, and urban youth demographics alongside Atiku’s established political machinery and influence across parts of the North. Under the Nigerian Constitution, a winning candidate must secure a plurality of votes and at least 25 per cent of the votes in two-thirds of the states (24 out of 36) plus the Federal Capital Territory. A dispassionate assessment of the current state of affairs shows that neither Obi nor Atiku can singlehandedly attain this threshold. The most significant hurdle in any merger would be deciding who takes the presidential slot. If Atiku heads the ticket, it might alienate Obi’s supporters in the South-East and many reform-minded voters who view Obi as a symbol of structural political change. If Obi heads the ticket, it could face friction from impatient traditional northern political elites who can’t wait for power to return to the North. The accepted wisdom in political circles is that 80-year-old Atiku cannot conceivably accept being vice president to Obi, while Kwankwaso will rue being left out in the cold in the event of an Atiku/Obi ticket. It’s all about self-interest. Until the elections come and go, you cannot vouch for where some of the major players will eventually cast their lot. The looming ghost of tribal/geopolitical manoeuvres cannot be discountenanced in the calculus. If the wishes of many northern opposition elements were horses, Peter Obi will subordinate his ambition to Atiku and agree to play second fiddle. As already stated, an alliance of the two leaders would fundamentally reshape the political landscape, presenting a formidable challenge to President Tinubu and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC). The recent gathering of anti-Tinubu elements in the G-100 is a significant development. The coalition has tried to bypass direct ego clashes by setting up joint legal and media committees to manage expectations, but individual loyalists often pressure their preferred principals not to compromise. While national opposition leaders negotiate a mega-coalition in Abuja, local state chapters operate under entirely different survival tensions. In many states, opposition parties (such as factions of the PDP, SDP, and ADC) are fierce rivals at the local level. If a national coalition mandates that a specific party yield its structure in a particular state to accommodate another coalition partner, local party executives often rebel, leading to localised anti-coalition friction or secret parallel alignments. An example of how local politics and personal ambition affect loyalty can be seen in the case of the former deputy senate president, Ovie Omo-Agege, who defected to the National Democratic Congress (NDC) after he officially quit the All Progressives Congress (APC) in May. Internal friction and ticket rivalries within the APC played a central role in his defection to NDC, whose flag he will be flying in the race for the Delta Central Senatorial District in 2027. The looming ghost of tribal/geopolitical manoeuvres cannot be discountenanced in the calculus. If the wishes of many northern opposition elements were horses, Peter Obi will subordinate his ambition to Atiku and agree to play second fiddle. As already stated, an alliance of the two leaders would fundamentally reshape the political landscape, presenting a formidable challenge to President Tinubu and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC). But diehard Obi supporters will not be receptive to their hero reverting to the role of a spare tyre. Obi is the most credible face of the South-East in the current electoral race. The South-West has multiple notable aspirants, including President Bola Tinubu, Prince Adewole Adebayo and Governor Seyi Makinde, while the North-East features figures such as Atiku Abubakar and Mohammed Hayatuddeen. The South-South has Rotimi Amaechi. The North-Central and North-West regions are yet to produce strong frontline contenders. Perhaps the three regions in the North are strategically avoiding multiple aspirants to prevent vote splitting? There are other strategic machinations in the mix. If you have your ears to the ground, you will hear the whispering campaign in the North of a plan to encourage political attrition between the South-West and South-East, so that while the Yoruba and Igbo Turks of the South are at each other’s throats, the Northern elite can perfect their plan of installing one of their own in power. It sounds so childishly pedestrian at first until you re-analyse the verbal effusions of one of the perennial appointees whose definition of the ‘North’ is “I, Me and Myself”. …If the election were contested under the existing multi-candidate dynamic (APC, PDP, LP, NNPP), despite economic headwinds, President Tinubu and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) can secure a national plurality, even with a reduced vote share, dependent on state spread requirements. The Northern Elders’ Forum and other such bodies who could have led the way in campaigning for their elected governors to banish the almajiri system (which hides under the cloak of religion to legitimise destitution), and other social drawbacks in the region are suddenly awake in this season of political horse-trading. Their critics are asking where they were when Buhari was running for a second term after his uneventful first leg. There will always be jostling for elbow room between various ethnic nationalities, but I think the Yoruba and Igbo wouldn’t be foolish enough to swallow the bait of seasoned provocateurs determined to drive a wedge between them. Elections will come and go. People will remain. The same admonition goes to the fake reprisalists in the north, who are always ready to justify ethnic cleansing and forceful takeover of other people’s ancestral lands in the name of revenging some ancient indeterminate wrongs done by the routed victims. In this season of electioneering, we are seeing how some people are digging up their demons from infernal depths in the name of political strategy. Difficult as it may seem, the opposition should either come together to put their best combination forward or be prepared to lick their wounds as disparate vanquished wannabes. (a) If the election were contested under the existing multi-candidate dynamic (APC, PDP, LP, NNPP), despite economic headwinds, President Tinubu and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) can secure a national plurality, even with a reduced vote share, dependent on state spread requirements. Wole Olaoye is a Public Relations consultant and veteran journalist. He can be reached on [email protected] , Twitter: @wole_olaoye; Instagram: woleola2021
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 蒂努布面临的不利局势，Wole Olaoye撰文
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh: 总统候选人博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布即使没有总统光环，也已经足够强悍。如今，所有总统权力都掌握在他手中，因此在即将举行的选举中，必须将他视为领跑者。然而，一些阻力表明，虽然他令人敬畏，却并非不可战胜。多年来，他的许多对手的问题在于，他们没有认真对待他。这种思维的一个体现是，反对派依靠翻来覆去讲述蒂努布的失误来影响选民，而不是针对他一些显然不受欢迎的政策提出替代方案。就目前情况而言，其他总统候选人中没有人具备足够的威望，能够击败蒂努布。执政的进步大会党（APC）是唯一公布了竞选架构并启动拉票机制的政党。所有反对党仅有83天时间来扭转当前局势。正如我稍后在本文中论证的那样，如果ADC的阿提库·阿布巴卡尔与NDC的彼得·奥比联手，推出反蒂努布人士所称的“梦幻组合”，比赛才会真正变得有意思。2023年，反对派选票分散在人民民主党（PDP）、工党（LP）和尼日利亚全国进步党（NNPP）之间。奥比与阿提库若组成统一竞选组合，便可能整合双方庞大的选民基础——把奥比在东南部、南南地区以及城市青年群体中的强劲势头，与阿提库成熟的政治机器及其在北部部分地区的影响结合起来。根据尼日利亚宪法，获胜候选人必须取得最高票数，并在36个州中的至少三分之二，即24个州，加上联邦首都区，获得至少25%的选票。冷静评估当前局势可见，奥比和阿提库都无法单独达到这一门槛。任何合并面临的最大障碍，是决定由谁担任总统候选人。如果阿提库领衔竞选，可能会疏远奥比在东南部的支持者，以及许多把奥比视为结构性政治变革象征的改革派选民。如果奥比领衔竞选，则可能遭到 impatient 的北方传统政治精英的阻力，他们迫不及待地希望权力回到北方。政治圈普遍认为，80岁的阿提库根本不可能接受担任奥比的副总统；而如果阿提库与奥比组成竞选组合，夸恩瓦索也会因被冷落在外而懊恼。这一切都关乎个人利益。在选举尘埃落定之前，谁也无法保证一些主要参与者最终会把赌注押在哪里。在权衡利弊时，不能忽视部落主义或地缘政治操弄的阴影。如果北方许多反对派分子的意愿能够化作现实，彼得·奥比就会把个人野心置于阿提库之下，同意担任配角。正如已经指出的，两位领袖结盟将从根本上重塑政治格局，对蒂努布总统和执政的进步大会党（APC）构成严峻挑战。反蒂努布人士近期在G-100的聚首是一项重要发展。该联盟试图通过设立联合法律和媒体委员会来管理各方期待，绕开正面的个人冲突，但各方铁杆支持者经常向自己拥戴的领导人施压，要求其不让步。在全国反对派领袖于阿布贾商谈组建大联盟之际，各州地方分支却处于完全不同的生存压力之下。在许多州，反对党——例如人民民主党（PDP）、社会民主党（SDP）和ADC的各派系——在地方层面互为死敌。如果全国联盟要求某个党在特定州让出其组织架构，以容纳另一联盟伙伴，地方党务主管往往会抗命，进而引发局部反联盟摩擦或秘密的平行结盟。前副参议员奥维·奥莫阿耶盖的案例，展示了地方政治和个人野心如何影响忠诚度。他于5月正式退出进步大会党（APC）后，转投民主全国大会党（NDC）；2027年争夺三角洲中部参议员席位时，他将代表NDC参选。部落主义或地缘政治操弄的阴影挥之不去，在权衡利弊时不能予以忽视。如果北方许多反对派分子的意愿能够化作现实，彼得·奥比就会把个人野心置于阿提库之下，同意担任配角。正如已经指出的，两位领袖结盟将从根本上重塑政治格局，对蒂努布总统和执政的进步大会党（APC）构成严峻挑战。但奥比的铁杆支持者不会接受自己的英雄退居备胎角色。在当前选举竞争中，奥比是东南部最具可信度的政治面孔。西南部有多位 noteworthy 的政治抱负者，包括博拉·蒂努布总统、阿德沃勒·阿德巴约王子和塞伊·马金德州长；东北部则有阿提库·阿布巴卡尔和穆罕默德·哈亚图丁等人物。南南部有罗蒂米·阿梅奇。中北部和西北部地区尚未推出强劲的一线竞争者。或许，北方这三个地区正在战略上避免推出多名候选人，以防选票分流？其中还有其他战略盘算。如果贴近地面倾听，就会听见北方正在暗中谋划一项计划，鼓励西南部与东南部之间发生政治消耗，使南部的约鲁巴人与伊博人彼此争斗之际，北方精英便能完善其让自家人掌权的计划。乍听之下，这种做法显得幼稚而低级，直至重新审视某位长期获委任者的言辞——他对“北方”的定义是“我、我本人和我自己”……如果选举在现有多候选人格局（APC、PDP、LP、NNPP）下进行，尽管存在经济逆风，蒂努布总统和执政的进步大会党（APC）仍可能在全国范围内取得最高票数。即使得票率下降，只要满足各州得票分布要求，仍能获胜。北方长老论坛等原本可以率先展开竞选，敦促他们选出的州长废除游牧牧童制度——这种制度披着宗教外衣，使贫困获得合法化——以及处理该地区其他社会弊端的团体，在这个政治交易季节突然活跃起来。批评者质问他们：布哈里在毫无波澜的第一个任期结束后竞选连任时，他们在哪里？各族群之间总会为生存空间相互争挤，但我认为，约鲁巴人和伊博人不会愚蠢到吞下老练煽动者抛出的诱饵；这些人一心要在两族之间楔入分裂。选举会过去，投票也会过去，但人民会留下。同样的告诫也适用于北方那些虚假报复者，他们总准备好以要为受害者祖先土地上的某些古老而无法确定的冤屈复仇为借口，为种族清洗和武力夺取他人祖传土地辩护。在这个拉票季节，我们看到有些人打着政治策略的旗号，从地狱深处掘出自己的恶魔。无论多么困难，反对派要么联合起来推出最佳组合，要么准备舔舐伤口，以四分五裂的败者姿态各自挣扎。(a) 如果选举在现有多候选人格局（APC、PDP、LP、NNPP）下进行，尽管存在经济逆风，蒂努布总统和执政的进步大会党（APC）仍可能在全国范围内取得最高票数。即使得票率下降，只要满足各州得票分布要求，仍能获胜。沃莱·奥拉oye是公共关系顾问和资深记者。可通过[电子邮件保护]与之联系；推特：@wole_olaoye；Instagram：woleola2021

https://punchng.com/grid-stability-takes.body: Power supply, grid reliability and investment will take centre stage at the 13th edition of Nigeria Energy conference, the organisers have said. Scheduled to be held from 27 to 29 October in Lagos, the organisers said in a statement that the event would bring together government officials, regulators, investors, energy suppliers and industry experts to discuss measures to improve electricity delivery and address Nigeria’s persistent power challenges. More than 1,500 conference delegates are expected to attend the event, which will feature over 40 sessions and more than 120 speakers discussing grid performance, generation reliability, investment and the country’s growing electricity needs, the organisers said. They noted that despite significant installed generation capacity, Nigeria continued to face challenges relating to transmission infrastructure, gas availability and reliable electricity supply, underscoring the need to translate energy sector reforms into measurable improvements for consumers and businesses. “Nigeria’s electricity challenge is no longer just about investment, policy reforms or installed capacity; it is about delivering reliable, affordable and accessible power to the people and businesses that need it most. Until electricity is consistently available to the average Nigerian household and businesses can operate without the crippling cost of alternative power, our energy transition remains incomplete,” the Exhibition Director, Energy Portfolio, inD, Ade Yesufu, said. It was stated that the leadership summit would examine investment, grid performance, electricity market reforms and gas-to-power reliability, including a debate on whether Nigeria’s power market was ready to scale up to 10,000 megawatts. Dare Olawin is a journalist at Punch Newspapers with over a decade of reporting experience. He began his career as a community reporter and now covers the energy sector, including oil, gas, electricity, and renewables. https://punchng.com/grid-stability-takes.body_zh: 组织者表示，电力供应、电网可靠性和投资将成为第13届尼日利亚能源大会的核心议题。大会定于10月27日至29日在拉各斯举行。组织者在声明中表示，此次活动将汇集政府官员、监管机构、投资者、能源供应商和行业专家，共同讨论改善电力输送的措施，应对尼日利亚持续存在的电力挑战。预计将有超过1,500名大会代表出席活动。活动将设置40多场分论坛，并有120多名演讲者讨论电网表现、发电可靠性、投资以及该国不断增长的用电需求。组织者指出，尽管尼日利亚拥有可观的装机发电容量，但该国仍面临输电基础设施、天然气供应和可靠供电等方面的挑战，这凸显了将能源部门改革转化为消费者和企业能够切实感受到的改善的必要性。能源组合展览总监Ade Yesufu表示：“尼日利亚的电力挑战已不再仅仅关乎投资、政策改革或装机容量；更重要的是，要向最需要电力的民众和企业输送可靠、经济且可及的电力。除非普通尼日利亚家庭能够持续用上电，企业也能摆脱替代电源高昂成本的制约，否则我们的能源转型仍不完整。”据称，本次领导层峰会 将探讨投资、电网表现、电力市场改革和天然气发电可靠性，其中包括一场辩论：尼日利亚电力市场是否已准备好扩大至10,000兆瓦。Dare Olawin是《Punch Newspapers》的记者，拥有十多年报道经验。他的职业生涯始于社区记者，如今负责报道能源领域，包括石油、天然气、电力和可再生能源。Dare的工作体现了深入一线的编辑室经验、通过研讨会和专业会议取得的职业发展，以及对准确且富有洞察力的新闻报道的坚定追求。

https://leadership.ng/poverty-will-go-fu.title: “Poverty Will Go”: Full List Of Tinubu’s 2027 Promises As APC Flags Off Campaign In Kaduna
https://leadership.ng/poverty-will-go-fu.summary: Addressing supporters at the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign flag-off at Ranchers Bees Stadium on Saturday, October 24, Tinubu defended his economic reforms, dismissed opposition criticism of hunger and poverty and urged Nigerians to support him in the January 16, 2027 presidential election.
https://leadership.ng/poverty-will-go-fu.summary_zh: 10月24日星期六，在Ranchers Bees体育场举行的全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选启动仪式上，Tinubu向支持者发表讲话，为其经济改革辩护，驳回反对派对饥饿和贫困的批评，并敦促尼日利亚人在2027年1月16日总统选举中支持他。
https://leadership.ng/poverty-will-go-fu.body: Addressing supporters at the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign flag-off at Ranchers Bees Stadium on Saturday, October 24, Tinubu defended his economic reforms, dismissed opposition criticism of hunger and poverty and urged Nigerians to support him in the January 16, 2027 presidential election. The President maintained that his administration was working to eradicate hunger and poverty, insisting that opposition politicians who criticised his handling of the economy were responsible for the problems. “We have prosperity, consistency, growth, recovery and opportunity. I assure you of that,” he told the crowd. Tinubu also ruled out a return to the petrol subsidy regime, declaring that the policy was in the past, while highlighting infrastructure development as part of his administration’s record. However, the promises made in Kaduna echo several commitments he made during the 2023 presidential campaign, when he pledged to tackle poverty, improve food security, create jobs, strengthen security and expand electricity access. As the President seeks a second term, here are seven commitments from his Kaduna campaign launch and how they compare with the promises he made in 2023. At the Kaduna rally, Tinubu promised Nigerians prosperity, growth, recovery and opportunities, urging voters to give his administration another mandate to consolidate its policies. He also assured supporters that they would not regret voting for him again, presenting continuity as necessary to sustain the direction of his government. The promise comes amid public concerns over the cost of living, rising prices and the impact of the administration’s economic reforms. Since assuming office in May 2023, Tinubu has removed the petrol subsidy and introduced changes to the foreign exchange system, measures his government has defended as necessary to stabilise public finances and improve the economy. However, the reforms have also contributed to significant financial pressure on households, with higher transport and living costs becoming major concerns for Nigerians. In his 2023 Renewed Hope manifesto, Tinubu had pledged to restructure the economy to stimulate growth, create jobs, reduce unemployment and end extreme poverty. He also promised to promote domestic manufacturing, attract investment and improve the country’s productive capacity. One of the most prominent moments at the Kaduna rally came when Tinubu responded to criticism of his administration’s handling of hunger and poverty by blaming previous administrations and political opponents. “I hear my opponents talking about hunger. Who created it? They did. They created hunger and poverty. We are trying to eradicate them,” he said. The President’s remarks placed the fight against poverty at the centre of his second-term campaign, even as the opposition continues to criticise his economic policies. His promise to eradicate poverty also raises questions about how his administration intends to address the immediate challenges facing households struggling with food prices and other essential expenses. Tinubu pledged to end extreme poverty through economic growth, employment generation, social interventions and policies designed to improve the incomes of Nigerians. His manifesto also proposed measures to expand economic opportunities and improve living standards, particularly for vulnerable populations. Tinubu used the Kaduna rally to reaffirm his opposition to restoring the petrol subsidy, presenting its removal as a permanent break from a policy he considers costly and vulnerable to abuse. “What is past is past. Fuel subsidy is in our past. No more corruption, no more falsification of invoices, no more lies and no more smuggling,” he said. The President’s position signals that a return to the subsidy regime is unlikely to form part of his proposed second-term economic direction. However, subsidy removal remains one of the most contentious policies of his administration because of its effects on transport fares, food distribution and the cost of running businesses. In his inaugural address on May 29, 2023, Tinubu defended the phase-out of petrol subsidies, arguing that the savings should be redirected towards infrastructure, education, healthcare and employment. The policy became one of the defining decisions of his presidency, with the government subsequently defending its economic reform programme. The challenge for Tinubu is to demonstrate that the anticipated long-term benefits of the reform can outweigh the immediate financial burden on households and businesses. At the Kaduna rally, Tinubu defended his administration’s record on salary payments, declaring that the government pays salaries regularly and praising APC governors for their performance. “We pay salaries regularly. Our governors are working, and I am proud of them. They are developing their states,” he said. The statement formed part of his broader argument that his administration and its political allies were delivering results despite criticism from opposition parties. However, regular salary payments represent only one aspect of workers’ welfare. Purchasing power, wage adequacy and the ability of families to afford basic necessities remain important measures of economic wellbeing. Tinubu pledged to create meaningful economic opportunities, expand employment and promote policies that would improve the welfare of workers and vulnerable Nigerians. His manifesto also proposed a jobs and prosperity framework intended to support labour-intensive infrastructure projects, industrial development and improved social services. Tinubu’s pledge to eradicate hunger in Kaduna brings one of his most important 2023 campaign commitments back into focus: making food more available and affordable. Although the President blamed previous administrations and opposition politicians for the country’s hunger crisis, his Kaduna remarks did not provide a detailed new target or timetable for reducing food prices. Food affordability remains closely linked to agricultural production, transportation costs, insecurity in farming communities, storage facilities and the wider cost of doing business. Tinubu pledged to strengthen food security through agricultural hubs, improved storage facilities, agricultural processing and measures to reduce post-harvest losses. His manifesto also proposed commodity exchange boards to guarantee minimum prices for selected agricultural products, with the stated aim of improving farmers’ incomes while making food more affordable for consumers. He promised that food would become more abundant and less expensive. Infrastructure featured prominently in the Kaduna campaign launch, with Tinubu inaugurating an 81-kilometre section of the Abuja-Kaduna-Zaria-Kano dual carriageway. The project was presented by the Presidency as part of the administration’s investment in critical infrastructure and its efforts to improve transportation links across the North-West. Improved road infrastructure can reduce travel times, ease the movement of goods and connect agricultural producers to markets. However, the wider benefits depend on the quality of construction, maintenance and completion of connected sections of the road network. Tinubu pledged to prioritise national infrastructure networks covering roads, railways and ports. His manifesto also linked infrastructure development to industrial growth, employment generation and improved economic productivity. He further proposed redirecting resources previously spent on petrol subsidies towards infrastructure and other public services. In Kaduna, Tinubu appealed to Nigerians, including young people, to support his second-term bid, promising prosperity and a better tomorrow. His remarks presented the 2027 election as an opportunity to continue the administration’s policies and pursue the economic recovery he said was underway. However, the President did not announce a specific new employment target in the reported remarks at the flag-off. Tinubu pledged to create one million new jobs in the digital economy and introduce policies to stimulate employment through industrial development, infrastructure investment and support for businesses. His manifesto also identified women and young people as important beneficiaries of the administration’s economic and social policies. Whether the government can create more stable and productive jobs, expand opportunities for young people and improve access to digital skills, financing and business support. The key measure will be whether economic expansion produces employment opportunities that can absorb new entrants into the labour market and provide sustainable incomes. For young Nigerians, the promise of a better future will be judged by access to decent work and the ability to build independent livelihoods. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/poverty-will-go-fu.title_zh: “贫困将会消失”：提努布2027年完整承诺清单出炉，全民进步大会党在卡杜纳启动竞选活动
https://leadership.ng/poverty-will-go-fu.body_zh: 10月24日星期六，在全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选启动活动于Ranchers Bees体育场举行之际，蒂努布向支持者发表讲话，为其经济改革辩护，回斥反对派对饥饿和贫困的批评，并呼吁尼日利亚人在2027年1月16日总统选举中支持他。总统表示，其政府正在努力消除饥饿和贫困，并坚持认为，批评他处理经济问题的反对派政治人物应对这些问题负责。“我们拥有繁荣、稳定、增长、复苏和机遇。我向你们保证这一点。”他对人群说。蒂努布还排除恢复汽油补贴制度的可能性，宣布该政策已经成为过去，同时强调基础设施发展是其政府任期内的政绩之一。然而，他在卡杜纳作出的承诺，与2023年总统竞选期间提出的多项承诺如出一辙；当时他承诺解决贫困、改善粮食安全、创造就业、加强安全以及扩大电力供应。随着总统寻求连任，以下是他在卡杜纳竞选启动活动中作出的七项承诺，以及这些承诺与他2023年所作承诺的对比。在卡杜纳集会上，蒂努布向尼日利亚人承诺繁荣、增长、复苏和机遇，敦促选民再次授予其政府授权，以巩固各项政策。他还向支持者保证，他们不会后悔再次投票给他，并强调延续政策对于维持政府方向至关重要。这一承诺正值公众担忧生活成本、物价上涨以及政府经济改革所产生的影响之际。自2023年5月就任以来，蒂努布取消汽油补贴并对外汇制度作出调整；其政府为这些措施辩护，称它们是稳定公共财政、改善经济所必需的。然而，这些改革也给家庭带来显著经济压力，交通费用和生活成本上涨成为尼日利亚人关注的主要问题。在2023年《 renewed hope 》宣言中，蒂努布曾承诺重组经济，以刺激增长、创造就业、减少失业并终结极端贫困。他还承诺促进国内制造业发展、吸引投资并提升国家的生产能力。卡杜纳集会上最引人关注的时刻之一，是蒂努布回应其政府处理饥饿和贫困问题时受到的批评，并把责任归咎于历届政府和政治对手。“我听到对手在谈论饥饿。是谁造成的？是他们。他们造成了饥饿和贫困。我们正努力消除这些问题。”他说。总统的讲话把反贫困斗争置于其连任竞选的中心位置，尽管反对派仍在批评他的经济政策。他消除贫困的承诺也引出了一个问题：其政府打算如何应对家庭因食品价格和其他基本生活支出而承受的眼前困难。蒂努布承诺通过经济增长、创造就业、社会干预以及旨在提高尼日利亚人收入的政策来终结极端贫困。他的宣言还提出扩大经济机会、改善生活水平的措施，尤其面向弱势群体。蒂努布利用卡杜纳集会再次表明，他反对恢复汽油补贴，并把取消补贴描述为与一项成本高昂且容易遭到滥用的政策彻底决裂。“过去的事已经过去。燃油补贴已经成为我们的过去。不再有腐败，不再有发票造假，不再有谎言，也不再有走私。”他说。总统的立场表明，恢复补贴制度不太可能成为其第二任期经济方案的一部分。然而，由于取消补贴影响到交通票价、食品流通以及企业经营成本，该政策仍是其政府最具争议的政策之一。在2023年5月29日的就职演说中，蒂努布为逐步取消汽油补贴辩护，认为节省下来的资金应转用于基础设施、教育、医疗和就业。该政策成为其总统任期内的标志性决定之一，政府此后一直为其经济改革方案辩护。蒂努布面临的挑战，是证明改革预期带来的长期收益能够超过家庭和企业当前承受的经济负担。在卡杜纳集会上，蒂努布为其政府发放工资的政绩辩护，宣布政府定期支付工资，并赞扬APC州长的工作表现。“我们定期发放工资。我们的州长们正在开展工作，我为他们感到骄傲。他们正在发展各自的州。”他说。这番言论是其更广泛论辩的一部分，即尽管受到反对派批评，他的政府及其政治盟友仍在交出成果。然而，定期发放工资只是劳动者福祉的一个方面。购买力、工资是否足够，以及家庭负担基本生活必需品的能力，仍是衡量经济福祉的重要指标。蒂努布承诺创造有意义的经济机会、扩大就业，并推行改善劳动者和弱势尼日利亚人福祉的政策。他的宣言还提出就业与繁荣框架，旨在支持劳动密集型基础设施项目、工业发展以及改善社会服务。蒂努布在卡杜纳消除饥饿的承诺，再次凸显其2023年竞选期间最重要的承诺之一：让食品更容易获得、价格更实惠。尽管总统把国家的饥饿危机归咎于历届政府和反对派政治人物，但他在卡杜纳的讲话并未为降低食品价格提出具体的新目标或时间表。食品价格承受能力与农业生产、运输成本、农业生产社区的不安全局势、仓储设施以及整体经营成本密切相关。蒂努布承诺通过农业中心、改善仓储设施、发展农产品加工以及采取措施减少收获后损失来加强粮食安全。他的宣言还提出设立商品交易所委员会，为选定农产品保证最低价格，其明确目标是提高农民收入，同时让消费者能够以更低价格购买食品。他承诺食品将更加充足、价格更加低廉。基础设施在卡杜纳竞选启动活动中占据重要位置，蒂努布为阿布贾—卡杜纳—扎里亚—卡诺双向车道的一段81公里路段主持启用仪式。该项目由总统府介绍，是政府投资关键基础设施、改善西北地区交通联系努力的一部分。改善道路基础设施可以缩短出行时间、便利货物运输，并把农业生产者与市场连接起来。然而，更广泛的益处取决于建筑质量、维护情况以及相连路段能否完工。蒂努布承诺优先发展涵盖公路、铁路和港口的国家基础设施网络。他的宣言还把基础设施发展与工业增长、创造就业和提高经济生产率联系起来。他还提议把此前用于汽油补贴的资源转投基础设施和其他公共服务。在卡杜纳，蒂努布呼吁尼日利亚人，包括年轻人，支持他竞选连任，并承诺带来繁荣和更美好的明天。他的讲话把2027年选举描绘成继续推行政府政策、推进他所说的正在进行的经济复苏的机会。然而，在有关竞选启动活动的报道中，总统并未宣布具体的新增就业目标。蒂努布承诺在数字经济中创造100万个新岗位，并推出政策，通过工业发展、基础设施投资和支持企业来刺激就业。他的宣言还把妇女和年轻人列为政府经济与社会政策的重要受益者。政府能否创造更多稳定且富有成效的岗位、扩大年轻人的机会并改善其获取数字技能、融资和业务支持的条件，仍有待观察。关键衡量标准在于，经济扩张能否创造就业机会，吸纳新进入劳动力市场的人，并为其提供可持续收入。对年轻尼日利亚人而言，美好未来的承诺将取决于他们能否获得体面工作，以及能否建立独立谋生的能力。我们掌握第一手信息。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/2026.summary_zh: 得克萨斯州奥斯汀——基米·安东内利周日在美国大奖赛中强势夺得本赛季第九场胜利，进一步巩固了自己在一级方程式锦标赛中的领先优势，并有望在下一场墨西哥城站捧起总冠军。不过，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿获得第四名，而积分榜上遥遥领先的梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔仅获第八名，勉强让冠军争夺继续延续至墨西哥城大奖赛所在的埃尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/2026.body: AUSTIN, Texas — Kimi Antonelli stormed to his ninth win of the season on Sunday at the United States Grand Prix and further tightened his grip on a Formula 1 season championship that he could win at the next race in Mexico City. The Mercedes driver started from pole position at the Circuit of the Americas with an outside chance of winning the season championship outright. A victory combined with poor results from his closest rivals would have done it. But Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton finished fourth and Mercedes' George Russell, who is a distant second in the standings, finished eighth to barely keep the title chase alive, sending it to the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez at the Mexico City Grand Prix. “It was a result we needed, the whole team deserve it so much,” Antonelli said. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc finished second, more than 14 seconds behind Antonelli. Red Bull's Max Verstappen was third. The 20-year-old Antonelli is on the brink of becoming F1’s youngest champion in series history, and the first Italian to win the title since Alberto Ascari in 1953. He made easy work of Sunday's race with a blistering start that blew Verstappen off the line as he eased into the first corner. The uphill left-turn switchback is one of the most notorious collision spots of the season and it was no trouble on this day. Verstappen has struggled with his starts several times this season, and Antonelli’s blast into the first corner never gave Verstappen a chance to win the inside line. Instead, the four-time champion quickly found himself in a fight with the two Ferrari cars while Antonelli drove off into the distance and seized control of the race. From there, it was a matter of managing the race as Mercedes watched to see where Russell and Hamilton would finish. “Another small step,” Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff told Antonelli over the radio after the victory. “Another small step.” The biggest one could come next week in front of one of the biggest, most boisterous crowds of the season. Antonelli needs to finish only ninth or higher in Mexico City to clinch the championship. “We are very close, but we try to finish on a high and we try to clinch (the title) very soon," Antonelli said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/2026.title_zh: 基米·安东内利赢得美国大奖赛，进一步紧握F1历史性冠军争夺战主动权
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/2026.body_zh: 得克萨斯州奥斯汀——基米·安东内利周日在美国大奖赛中强势夺得本赛季第九场胜利，进一步巩固了自己在Formula 1世界锦标赛中的领先优势，并有望在下一站的墨西哥城站直接夺冠。梅赛德斯车手在美国赛道以杆位发车，仍有机会直接赢得赛季总冠军。只要夺冠，再加上最接近的对手表现不佳，他就能实现这一目标。然而，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿获得第四名，积分榜上遥遥领先的梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔仅获第八名，总冠军之争勉强延续至墨西哥城大奖赛的赫曼努斯·罗德里格斯赛车场。安东内利说：“这是我们需要的结果，整个团队都非常配得上这份胜利。”法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔获得第二名，落后安东内利超过14秒。红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘获得第三名。20岁的安东内利即将成为F1历史上最年轻的车总冠军，并成为自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位赢得该头衔的意大利人。周日比赛中，他凭借凌厉的起步轻松取胜，在驶入第一个弯道时甩开了维斯塔潘。上坡的左弯回头弯是本赛季最臭名昭著的碰撞地点之一，但当天对安东内利来说毫无难度。维斯塔潘本赛季多次在发车环节陷入困境，安东内利冲入第一个弯道时，维斯塔潘根本没有机会抢到内线。相反，这位四届冠军车手很快发现自己陷入与两辆法拉利赛车缠斗的局面，而安东内利则一路远去掌控了比赛。此后，比赛只剩下管理节奏的问题，梅赛德斯则观察拉塞尔和汉密尔顿最终的名次。夺冠后，梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫通过无线电对安东内利说：“又向前迈了一小步。”“又向前迈了一小步。”最大的一步可能就在下周到来，在本赛季规模最大、最热情喧闹的车迷群体面前实现。安东内利在墨西哥城只需获得第九名或更好的名次，就能确保夺冠。安东内利说：“我们已经非常接近了，但我们会以高位完赛，也会争取很快锁定（总冠军）。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Samsung, SK hynix shareholder return policies in focus ahead of Q3 earnings
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Shareholder return policies of Samsung Electronics and SK hynix are gaining market attention ahead of their announcements for third-quarter earnings, as investors see them as a key way to address the mismatch between the chipmakers' record-breaking profits and their sluggish share prices. Samsung Electronics is set to announce its three-month financial results during its earnings call on Thursday, while SK hynix said it will announce its results on its earnings call on Wednesday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 在Samsung Electronics和SK hynix发布第三季度业绩公告之前，两家公司的股东回报政策正日益受到市场关注。投资者认为，这是解决两家芯片制造商创纪录利润与疲弱股价之间落差的关键途径。Samsung Electronics定于周四在业绩电话会议上公布其三个月财务业绩，SK hynix则表示将在周三的业绩电话会议上公布业绩。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Shareholder return policies of Samsung Electronics and SK hynix are gaining market attention ahead of their announcements for third-quarter earnings, as investors see them as a key way to address the mismatch between the chipmakers' record-breaking profits and their sluggish share prices. Samsung Electronics is set to announce its three-month financial results during its earnings call on Thursday, while SK hynix said it will announce its results on its earnings call on Wednesday. Earnings are expected to be exceptionally strong, as surging demand for memory chips and continued supply bottlenecks have driven up average selling prices across the memory chip market. In its earnings guidance released Oct. 8, Samsung Electronics estimated third-quarter revenue of 195 trillion won ($146.96 billion) and operating profit of 107.4 trillion won. If realized, the company will become the first Korean company to surpass 100 trillion won in quarterly operating profit. SK hynix is expected to post 98.23 trillion won in revenue and 76.96 trillion won in operating profit during the same period, according to the consensus of brokerage estimates compiled by market tracker FnGuide. Both figures would mark all-time highs for the company. Despite the upbeat earnings outlook, neither company's shares have gained upward momentum. Samsung Electronics shares fell 18.2 percent from 261,000 won on Sept. 1 to 213,500 won on Friday, while SK hynix shares declined 25.4 percent from 1,693,000 won to 1,263,000 won over the same period. Compared with their respective 52-week highs, Samsung Electronics shares were down 43.8 percent, while SK hynix shares had plunged 57.9 percent. Against this backdrop, market attention is turning to how the two chipmakers will use shareholder return policies to buoy their share prices. In August, Samsung Electronics’ board approved a shareholder return plan worth between 90 trillion won and 110 trillion won for this year, under its existing policy of returning 50 percent of free cash flow (FCF) generated between 2024 and 2026 to shareholders. Of the total, the company is expected to announce details of approximately 30 trillion won in dividends around the earnings call, including the exact amount and payment date. Samsung plans to determine how to return the remaining amount to shareholders following a board review in January next year, once its 2026 financial results are finalized. Despite the potential shareholder returns of up to 110 trillion won, the announcement disappointed the market because the company maintained its existing policy of returning 50 percent of FCF without increasing the payout ratio, and there was no mention of additional share buybacks or cancellations. Samsung Electronics currently faces constraints on canceling large amounts of additional treasury common shares. Under Korean regulations, financial institutions are prohibited from holding more than a combined 10 percent stake in a nonfinancial company. Samsung Life Insurance and Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance already hold a combined stake approaching that threshold in Samsung Electronics, meaning further cancellations of common shares could push their ownership above the limit, triggering market observers to speculate about the cancellation of the company’s preferred shares. Also, the company’s existing policy of returning 50 percent of FCF expires this year, raising the possibility that management could drop hints about its policy for 2027 and beyond during the third-quarter earnings call. SK hynix is also expected to add more clarity to its shareholder return policy during the third-quarter earnings call. In August, the company pledged to return at least 50 percent of its cumulative FCF generated between 2025 and 2027 to shareholders, saying it will consider special dividends and additional share buybacks and cancellations. The company said that it will disclose further details on the scale and methods of additional shareholder returns during the third-quarter earnings call. Since August, SK hynix has bought back its treasury shares worth 40 trillion won, and plans to cancel them in the near future. Though the company completed the buyback program about a month ahead of schedule, its shares have remained sluggish, raising expectations that additional shareholder returns could be substantial. “We expect the company to have at least 30 trillion won in additional funds available for shareholder returns based on its FCF,” Hana Securities analyst Kim Rok-ho said. “We believe share buybacks and cancellations will play a greater role than dividends.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 第三季度财报公布前，Samsung和SK hynix的股东回报政策成为关注焦点
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 在三星电子和SK海力士发布第三季度业绩之前，两家公司的股东回报政策正日益受到市场关注，投资者认为这是解决芯片制造商创纪录利润与疲弱股价之间错配问题的一项关键途径。三星电子定于周四在业绩电话会议上公布其三个月财务业绩，而SK海力士表示将在周三的业绩电话会议上公布业绩。由于存储芯片需求激增且供应瓶颈持续，整个存储芯片市场的平均售价随之上涨，业绩预计将非常强劲。三星电子在10月8日发布的业绩指引中估计，其第三季度营收为195万亿韩元（146.96 billion美元），营业利润为107.4万亿韩元。若这一预期实现，该公司将成为首家季度营业利润突破100万亿韩元的韩国企业。据市场追踪机构FnGuide汇总的券商估计共识，SK海力士同期预计实现营收98.23万亿韩元，营业利润76.96万亿韩元。这两项数字都将刷新该公司的历史最高纪录。尽管业绩前景乐观，两家公司的股价均未获得上涨动能。三星电子股价从9月1日的261,000韩元跌至周五的213,500韩元，跌幅为18.2%；同期，SK海力士股价从1,693,000韩元跌至1,263,000韩元，跌幅为25.4%。与各自52周高点相比，三星电子股价下跌43.8%，SK海力士股价则暴跌57.9%。在此背景下，市场正关注这两家芯片制造商将如何运用股东回报政策支撑股价。今年8月，三星电子董事会批准了一项价值90万亿至110万亿韩元的年度股东回报计划。根据公司现行政策，其将把2024年至2026年产生的自由现金流（FCF）的50%返还给股东。在这一总额中，公司预计将在业绩电话会议前后公布约30万亿韩元股息的具体安排，包括准确金额和支付日期。三星计划在明年1月董事会审查2026年最终财务业绩后，确定如何将剩余资金返还给股东。尽管股东回报规模最高可达110万亿韩元，但这一消息仍令市场失望，因为公司维持了返还50% FCF的现行政策，未提高派息比率，也未提及额外回购或注销股份。三星电子目前受到注销大量新增库存普通股的限制。根据韩国监管规定，金融机构不得合计持有非金融公司超过10%的股份。Samsung Life Insurance和Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance在三星电子的合计持股比例已接近这一上限，这意味着进一步注销普通股可能推高两家公司的持股比例并突破限制，从而引发市场观察人士猜测，公司可能会注销其优先股。此外，公司现行返还50% FCF的政策将于今年到期，因此管理层可能在第三季度业绩电话会议上暗示其2027年及以后股东回报政策的走向。SK海力士预计也将在第三季度业绩电话会议上进一步明确其股东回报政策。今年8月，该公司承诺向股东返还2025年至2027年累计FCF的至少50%，并表示将考虑发放特别股息以及额外回购和注销股份。公司表示，将在第三季度业绩电话会议上披露额外股东回报的规模和具体方式。自8月以来，SK海力士已回购价值40万亿韩元的库存股，并计划在近期予以注销。尽管该公司提前约一个月完成回购计划，但股价依然疲弱，这提高了市场对额外股东回报规模可能十分可观的预期。Hana Securities分析师Kim Rok-ho表示：“根据其FCF，我们预计公司至少还有30万亿韩元可用于股东回报。我们认为，股份回购和注销将发挥比股息更大的作用。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title: First Chowan chancellor Chris White receives honorary doctorate from Seoul Cyber University
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary: For Christopher White, the first chancellor of Chowan University, nearly five decades in higher education have been guided by a belief that education should create opportunities for everyone, regardless of their background or financial circumstances. in religion from Emory University in Atlanta and served as vice president of Elon University, 10th president of Gardner-Webb University and 22nd president and first chancellor of Chowan University.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 对Chowan大学首任校监克里斯托弗·怀特而言，近50年的高等教育生涯始终贯穿着一种信念：教育应为每个人创造机会，无论其出身背景或经济状况如何。他拥有亚特兰大埃默里大学的宗教研究学位，曾任Elon大学副校长、Gardner-Webb大学第10任校长，以及Chowan大学第22任校长兼首任校监。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: For Christopher White, the first chancellor of Chowan University, nearly five decades in higher education have been guided by a belief that education should create opportunities for everyone, regardless of their background or financial circumstances. That philosophy took root during his childhood in a small town in the U.S. state of Georgia, where he grew up as the son of a small business owner and learned the importance of hard work, honesty, courtesy and respect for others. “I was taught to think big and to pursue big dreams wherever they may take me,” White said, recalling how his family encouraged him to pursue higher education. That encouragement set him on a career path that began as a professor of religion before taking him into university administration, where he eventually rose to senior leadership positions. White holds a Ph.D. in religion from Emory University in Atlanta and served as vice president of Elon University, 10th president of Gardner-Webb University and 22nd president and first chancellor of Chowan University. He is now senior fellow for international partnerships at Anderson University. On Thursday, White was recognized for his work in education with an honorary doctorate from Seoul Cyber University (SCU), with which he has also had ties for more than 30 years. "I am so pleased with the university's growth from modest beginnings to an intellectual powerhouse," White said. "The receipt of the honorary doctorate is a significant event in my life, and I am both humbled and grateful. In many ways this is a culmination of friendship, encouragement and international understanding." His relationship with SCU began in 1995, when a friend who was a university president introduced him to Lee Se-ung, the school’s honorary chairman. The two men had an almost instant rapport, bonding as devoted Christians who value family and heritage. "We both want to provide opportunities for higher education to as many people as possible, especially those with modest finances. We both value international relationships. We both have big ideas along with the courage to make those dreams become reality," White said. White added that he remains impressed by Lee’s vision of expanding the high school founded by Lee’s father into a companion university. “What great vision he continues to have and the courage to act to fulfill that vision.” Relationships matter to White well beyond the one with Lee. University growth in numbers, quality and finances was important, but the most rewarding parts of his experience as university president involved relationships with people. The most rewarding of those, White said, was the opportunity to provide a college education for more than two dozen Palestinian Christian students from the Holy Land, including Jerusalem, Bethlehem and Ramallah. "These students were gifted but had no resources for education. Life for Palestinian Christians in the Holy Land is very difficult. They are now doctors, scientists, educators and the like all over the world." But leadership was not always rewarding, White said. Though he never planned it, he has been thrust into such roles throughout his life. "Being a leader comes with costs. I resonate with the three costs of leadership that I found from some forgotten source. First, you will have to make hard decisions that could negatively affect people that you care about. Second, you will be disliked despite your best efforts to do the best for the most. Third, you will be misunderstood and will not always have the opportunity to defend yourself." Yet White has a simple message for the many SCU students who balance their studies with full-time jobs: Life is good and every day is a blessing. "I have learned that life is never easy. It has its joys and successes, and it has heartbreak and disappointments. I just keep on keeping on and try to not let problems weigh me down. I prefer to see problems as opportunities."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 首任乔瓦恩大学校长克里斯·怀特获首尔Cyber大学授予荣誉博士学位
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 对于乔瓦恩大学首任校长Christopher White来说，近50年的高等教育生涯始终受一个信念指引：教育应当为每个人创造机会，无论其背景或经济状况如何。这一理念源于他的童年。他在美国佐治亚州一个小镇长大，作为一名小企业主的儿子，他从小便学会了勤奋、诚实、礼貌和尊重他人的重要。“有人教我要胸怀大志，无论梦想把我带向何处，都要勇敢追求。”White回忆说，家人曾鼓励他接受高等教育。这份鼓励开启了他的职业道路，他最初担任宗教学教授，后来进入大学管理层，并逐步晋升至高级领导岗位。White拥有亚特兰大Emory University的宗教学博士学位，曾担任Elon University副校长、Gardner-Webb University第10任校长，以及乔瓦恩大学第22任校长兼首任校长。现任Anderson University国际合作高级研究员。周四，White因其教育领域的工作获Seoul Cyber University（SCU）授予荣誉博士学位，他与该校也已有30多年的联系。“我非常欣慰，这所大学从最初 modest beginnings 成长为学术重镇。”White说，“获得荣誉博士学位是我生命中的一件大事，我既感到谦卑，也心怀感激。在很多方面，这是友谊、鼓励和国际理解的圆满成果。”他与SCU的联系始于1995年，当时一位担任大学校长的朋友将他介绍给该校荣誉董事长Lee Se-ung。两人几乎立刻建立了深厚情谊，因为都是重视家庭和传统的虔诚基督徒而 bonded。“我们都想为尽可能多的人提供高等教育机会，尤其是经济条件有限的人。我们都重视国际关系。我们都有宏大的理想，也有勇气让梦想成为现实。”White还补充说，Lee将其父亲创办的高中扩展为一所配套大学的愿景令他至今印象深刻。“他始终拥有非凡的愿景，也有勇气采取行动去实现这一愿景。”对White来说，人际关系的重要性远不限于他与Lee之间的关系。大学在规模、质量和财务方面的发展固然重要，但在他担任大学校长的经历中，最令人满足的部分还是与人们建立联系。White说，其中最令人满足的是为来自圣地、包括耶路撒冷、伯利恒和拉马拉的20多名巴勒斯坦基督徒学生提供大学教育的机会。“这些学生很有天赋，但没有接受教育的资源。巴勒斯坦基督徒在圣地的生活非常艰难。如今，他们已成为世界各地的医生、科学家和教育工作者等。”不过，White表示，领导工作并非总能得到回报。尽管他从未主动规划，却一生中不断被推上此类岗位。“做领导是要付出代价的。我认同从某个不知名来源总结出的领导三重代价。第一，你必须作出艰难决定，而这些决定可能对你在乎的人造成不利影响。第二，即使你竭尽全力为多数人谋求最佳利益，仍会有人不喜欢你。第三，你会被人误解，而且并不总有机会为自己辩护。”然而，对于许多在兼顾学业和全职工作的SCU学生，White传达了一个简单的信息：生活是美好的，每一天都是祝福。“我明白，生活从来都不容易。生活有欢乐和成功，也有心碎和失望。我只是不断前进，努力不让问题压垮自己。我更愿意把问题看作机会。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Itaewon's Lit Lounge shines beacon through dark times over 4 years
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Lit Lounge opened the doors of its Itaewon location just about four years ago in late October 2022. "Lit Lounge's early existence was shaped by one of the most devastating tragedies in recent Korean history: The Itaewon Halloween crowd crush," said Jason Waller, owner of Lit Lounge. "For many of us operating businesses in Itaewon, the aftermath of this tragedy was even more devastating than the COVID-19 pandemic." It would have been understandable, maybe even advisable, if he just quit.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: Lit Lounge于2022年10月下旬在梨泰院开设门店，距今约四年。Lit Lounge业主Jason Waller表示：“Lit Lounge创立初期深受韩国近代最惨烈悲剧之一的影响，那就是梨泰院万圣节踩踏事件。对我们这些在梨泰院经营 businesses 的人来说，这场悲剧的后果甚至比COVID-19疫情更加毁灭性。”他若选择退出，或许可以理解，甚至不失为明智之举。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Lit Lounge opened the doors of its Itaewon location just about four years ago in late October 2022. Following a soft opening on Oct. 27 and 28, its grand opening was held on Saturday, Oct. 29, a day that would go down in infamy, after 159 people died in a crowd disaster in a narrow alley a little less than 400 meters away. "Lit Lounge's early existence was shaped by one of the most devastating tragedies in recent Korean history: The Itaewon Halloween crowd crush," said Jason Waller, owner of Lit Lounge. "For many of us operating businesses in Itaewon, the aftermath of this tragedy was even more devastating than the COVID-19 pandemic." It would have been understandable, maybe even advisable, if he just quit. But Waller, also known as Pinnacle TheHustler, decided to keep going. "I think the biggest reason I refused to close Lit Lounge was because I didn't want to look in the mirror and see someone who had given up. But for me, as long as I still believed in what I was building and I could still see a path forward, I wasn't ready to quit," he said. "And now, Lit Lounge, which started in 2022 is still alive, still growing and still getting better. Perseverance is a part of the foundation that makes me who I am." That may sound a bit boastful, but also in character for a former rapper who also calls himself Pinnacle TheHustler. "When I was a kid in about 7th or 8th grade, we came across the word 'pinnacle' in our vocabulary books. For some reason, I was just infatuated with this word, so I started putting it in a lot of my rhymes," the former rapper explained. "At that young age, I believed that whatever you wanted to do or be, you should strive to be the 'pinnacle' of that. If you wanna repair cars, then you should be the pinnacle of car repairs. If you're gonna be a baker, you better be the best baker around." When he was in high school, some other students were teasing him for using the word in so many of his rhymes, calling him "The Pinnacle," and he said it just stuck. "All my classmates started calling me 'Pinnacle," so I just rolled with it," he said. The second part came later, when he was getting ready to move to Korea after graduating college. "People knew me on campus as a hustler because of my strong work ethic," he said. "So when I announced my plans to go overseas, my friends were saying things like, 'oh, so you're going to be hustling on the other side of the world now? Pinnacle TheHustler!' So then the moniker 'Pinnacle TheHustler' was established and here I am, hustling on the other side of the world." Over here, he founded Planet Hustle Korea, an entertainment and consulting company, in 2015, that served as the parent company for all his physical business establishments in Seoul. This began with Club Hustle in August 2016. After it closed in January 2017, he brought the concept to Hustle Rooftop Lounge in May 2018. That one kept going, surviving through the pandemic until closing in July 2022. Also in 2022, he opened Lit Lounge in its first location, south of the river in affluent Apgujeong, where he said he faced significant challenges stemming from discriminatory attitudes due to the club's foreign ownership and customers. That led him to relocate Lit Lounge in October that same year. "Itaewon has always been known for its vibrant nightlife, but I wanted to create something a little different from the traditional nightlife experience," he said. He settled in Alley Market, a small maze of canopied alleyways just south of Itaewon-ro's western end. "When I first saw that alley, tucked away just off Itaewon's main street, I knew this was where I wanted to build," he said. "I wanted an area slightly removed from the chaos of the main strip, where I could focus on providing a more intentional experience for our guests." Lit Lounge's focus is on clean facilities, quality drinks, good music, attentive service and an environment where people can genuinely enjoy themselves. "I wanted to create a place where people could enjoy the best parts of nightlife without sacrificing comfort, quality or hospitality," he said. "Sometimes, we need the chaos of a fully packed, hot, sticky, sweaty club. And sometimes, we need the refinement of a clean lounge where your shoes still look nice at the end of your visit." In May 2025, with business going well, he acquired the neighboring space, where he opened Billion Bar. Both bars continue to operate next door to each other, offering two distinct nightlife experiences built around the same philosophy of hospitality, inclusivity and community. Lit Lounge is where people come to dance, laugh, enjoy hip-hop, R&B and Afrobeats music and meet new people. Billion Bar offers a more intimate environment where people can enjoy well-made cocktails, have conversations and participate in activities like karaoke and trivia. "Itaewon brings together people from all over the world, and I think that's what makes this neighborhood special," he said. "People come here for different reasons, but everyone wants to feel like they belong somewhere. If someone walks into one of my establishments alone and leaves having made a new friend, shared a laugh or experienced something memorable, then I feel like we've accomplished something meaningful. At the end of the day, I want our businesses to contribute something positive to the community that supports us." Although Alley Market has certainly seen better days, today it is home to a diverse collection of businesses. This includes restaurants like Linus BBQ and Nekkid Wings, nightlife establishments like Lit Lounge, Billion Bar and the newly reopened Phillies, and vintage shops like Paisley Cat and Hyso. "I believe we're witnessing the beginning of a new chapter," Waller said. "What was once a place where people gathered to buy and sell goods is becoming a place where people gather to eat, drink, socialize and experience different cultures. We are the new Alley Market, and together, we're bringing renewed energy and identity to this little corner of Itaewon." This Oct. 31, Lit Lounge is celebrating its fourth anniversary and Halloween on the same day. The celebration is branded "Comicalloween," and guests are encouraged to dress up as characters from movies and TV shows, from superheroes, villains and horror icons to animated favorites and cult classics. Entry costs 20,000 won and gets you into both venues. Visit planethustle.com for more information
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 梨泰院灯酒馆在长达4年的困境中点亮希望之光
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: Lit Lounge于2022年10月下旬在梨泰院开设门店，距今约四年。继10月27日至28日试营业后，其正式开业庆典于星期六10月29日举行，而这一天因不到400米外一条狭窄巷道发生拥挤灾难、导致159人死亡，将永远载入韩国社会的黑暗记忆。Lit Lounge老板Jason Waller表示：“Lit Lounge早期的存在受到近代韩国历史上最惨重的悲剧之一——梨泰院万圣节踩踏事件的塑造。对我们这些在梨泰院经营 businesses 的人来说，这场悲剧造成的冲击甚至比COVID-19疫情还要毁灭性。”如果他直接退出营业，或许可以理解，甚至不失为明智之举。但Waller仍决定继续坚持，他也以Pinnacle TheHustler为名。他说：“我认为，我拒绝关闭Lit Lounge的最大原因，是因为我不想在镜子里看到一个已经放弃的人。但对我来说，只要我仍然相信自己正在打造的事物，也仍然看得到前方的道路，我就还没准备好退出。如今，2022年创办的Lit Lounge依然存活、仍在成长，也仍在变得更好。坚韧是我成为今天的自己这一人生根基的一部分。”这听起来或许有些自夸，但也符合他这位前说唱歌手的身份——他同样以Pinnacle TheHustler自称。这位前说唱歌手解释道：“我大约读7年级或8年级时，在词汇书中看到了‘pinnacle’这个词。不知为何，我就迷上了这个词，于是开始在许多押韵词句中使用它。那时年纪很小，我以为，无论你想做什么、成为什么样的人，都应该努力成为那个领域的‘巅峰’。如果你想修车，就应该成为汽车维修的巅峰人物；如果你打算当面包师，那你最好成为周围最出色的面包师。”他读高中时，其他学生常取笑他在许多歌词中反复使用这个词，称他为“The Pinnacle”，而他表示这个称呼就这样沿用了下来。他说：“所有同学都开始叫我‘Pinnacle’，所以我就顺其自然了。”名字的后半部分是在他大学毕业准备移居韩国时才加上的。他说：“因为工作勤奋，校园里的人们知道我是个实干家。所以当我宣布计划出国时，朋友们就会说：‘哦，所以你如今要在世界另一边闯荡了？Pinnacle TheHustler！’于是，‘Pinnacle TheHustler’这个称号便由此确立，而我如今就在世界另一边闯荡。”2015年，他在韩国创办娱乐与咨询公司Planet Hustle Korea，由其作为他名下所有实体商业机构在首尔的母公司。创业始于2016年8月的Club Hustle。该店于2017年1月关闭后，他于2018年5月将这一理念带到Hustle Rooftop Lounge。这家店一直经营，经历疫情仍未倒闭，直至2022年7月结业。同样在2022年，他在河以南富裕的阿瑞贞首次开设Lit Lounge。他说，由于酒吧由外国人拥有且顾客也以外国人为主，歧视性态度给他带来了重大挑战。这促使他在同年10月将Lit Lounge迁址。他说：“梨泰院一直以热闹的夜生活闻名，但我想打造一种与传统夜生活体验略有不同的东西。”他最终落脚于Alley Market——这是一个由带顶棚的小巷组成的迷宫，位于梨泰院路西端以南不远处。他说：“第一次看到那条藏在梨泰院主街旁边的小巷时，我就知道这正是我想打造事业的地方。我想要一个稍微远离主街喧嚣的区域，在这里专注于为客人提供更有用心、更具品质感的体验。”Lit Lounge注重洁净的设施、优质酒饮、出色的音乐、周到的服务，以及让人们能够真正尽兴的环境。他说：“我想打造一个让人们无需牺牲舒适度、品质或待客之道，就能享受夜生活精华的地方。有时，我们需要一个挤满人群、闷热黏腻、令人汗流浃背的舞厅带来的混乱感；有时，我们也需要一间洁净雅致的酒廊，让客人离开时鞋子依然光鲜。”2025年5月，随着生意进展顺利，他收购了相邻场地，并在那里开设Billion Bar。两家酒吧至今比邻营业，以共同的待客、包容与社区理念为基础，提供两种截然不同的夜生活体验。Lit Lounge是人们跳舞、欢笑、欣赏嘻哈、R&B和Afrobeats音乐并结识新朋友的地方。Billion Bar则提供更私密的环境，让人们享用精心调制的鸡尾酒、交谈，并参与卡拉OK和知识问答等活动。他说：“梨泰院将来自世界各地的人汇聚在一起，我认为这正是这个社区的特别之处。人们因不同原因来到这里，但每个人都希望感觉自己属于某个地方。如果有人独自走进我的其中一家店，离开时结识了新朋友、共享了欢笑或经历了难忘的事，我便会觉得我们取得了有意义的成果。归根结底，我希望我们的企业能为支持我们的社区带来一些积极影响。”尽管Alley Market显然也经历过更风光的日子，如今这里已汇集各类多元商户，包括Linus BBQ和Nekkid Wings等餐厅，Lit Lounge、Billion Bar以及重新开业不久的Phillies等夜生活场所，以及Paisley Cat和Hyso等复古商店。Waller说：“我相信，我们正在见证一个新篇章的开端。这里曾经是人们聚集买卖商品的地方，如今正逐渐成为人们聚餐、饮酒、社交和体验不同文化的场所。我们就是全新的Alley Market，正共同为梨泰院这一小小角落注入新的活力与identity。本月31日，Lit Lounge将在同一天庆祝开业四周年和万圣节。庆祝活动以“Comicalloween”为品牌，鼓励客人装扮成电影和电视剧中的角色，从超级英雄、反派和恐怖片经典人物，到动画片宠儿与邪典经典。入场费为20,000韩元，可进入两家场所。详情请访问planethustle.com。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/26/n.title: Nigeria Judo Federation Assures Stakeholders of Fair Electoral Process
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/26/n.summary: The Caretaker Committee of the Nigeria Judo Federation (NJF) has reaffirmed its commitment to conducting a transparent, credible and inclusive electoral process, while maintaining its independence and neutrality in the discharge of its transitional responsibilities. However, it stressed that allegations, personal interests or preconceived positions will not be permitted to influence the electoral process.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/26/n.summary_zh: 尼日利亚柔道联合会（NJF）临时委员会重申，将致力于开展透明、可信和包容的选举流程，同时在履行过渡时期职责时保持独立与中立。不过，委员会强调，不允许指控、个人利益或预设立场影响选举进程。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/26/n.body: The Caretaker Committee of the Nigeria Judo Federation (NJF) has reaffirmed its commitment to conducting a transparent, credible and inclusive electoral process, while maintaining its independence and neutrality in the discharge of its transitional responsibilities. In a statement issued by the Committee Chairman, Sheriff Hammed, the Committee clarified its position following recent public comments and reports concerning its activities and mandate. The Committee emphasised that although it operates under the authority granted by the National Sports Commission (NSC), it remains fully committed to acting independently, fairly and in the best interests of Nigerian judo. “The Caretaker Committee is not a mouthpiece for any individual, group or interest, nor is it a platform for advancing personal or political agendas,” the statement said. The Committee acknowledged that it has received information and concerns regarding the conduct of certain individuals associated with the former Board. However, it stressed that allegations, personal interests or preconceived positions will not be permitted to influence the electoral process. According to the statement, the principles of transparency, fairness, due process and equal opportunity will continue to guide all decisions and actions of the Committee throughout the transition period. To ensure a level playing field, the Committee confirmed that all qualified and interested aspirants are welcome to obtain nomination forms and contest in the forthcoming elections, provided they meet the eligibility requirements outlined in the NJF Statutes and other applicable governance regulations. The Committee further assured stakeholders that no candidate would be unfairly excluded on the basis of personal disagreements, affiliations or considerations outside the established rules. The Committee called on all stakeholders, including state associations, athletes, coaches, referees and members of the judo community, to support a peaceful, transparent and orderly transition. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/26/n.title_zh: 尼日利亚柔道联合会向各方保证将举行公平的选举程序
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/26/n.body_zh: 尼日利亚柔道联合会（NJF）临时委员会重申，将致力于开展透明、可信且包容的选举程序，同时在履行过渡职责期间保持独立与中立。委员会主席Sheriff Hammed发表声明，就近期有关委员会活动及授权范围的公开评论和报道阐明立场。委员会强调，尽管其依据国家体育委员会（NSC）授予的权限开展工作，但仍将完全承诺独立、公正行事，并维护尼日利亚柔道的最佳利益。声明称：“临时委员会不是任何个人、团体或利益的喉舌，也不是推动个人或政治议程的平台。”委员会承认，已收到关于与前任理事会有关联的某些人士行为的信息和关切。然而，委员会强调，不会允许指控、个人利益或先入为主的态度影响选举程序。声明指出，在整个过渡期内，透明、公平、正当程序和平等机会原则将继续指导委员会的所有决定和行动。为确保公平竞争环境，委员会确认，所有符合条件且有意参选的申请人均可领取提名表并参加即将举行的选举，前提是其符合NJF章程及其他适用治理规定中列明的资格要求。委员会进一步向利益相关方保证，不会因个人分歧、关系隶属或既定规则之外的考量而不公平地排除任何候选人。委员会呼吁包括州级协会、运动员、教练、裁判和柔道界成员在内的所有利益相关方，共同支持和平、透明且有序的过渡。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，该报覆盖所有平台，服务于政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级，同时为有抱负人士和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。这份报纸是一项公共信任，致力于追求真相与理性，报道从突发新闻到政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区生活等广泛议题，展现人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/okon.title: Okonjo-Iweala loses mother, as Tinubu mourns
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/okon.summary: PRESIDENT Bola Tinubu has extended his heartfelt condolences to the Okonjo royal family of Ogwashi-Uku, Delta State, on the passing of Prof. Kamene Okonjo, who died at the age of 96. The President particularly commiserated with her daughter, Dr Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, Director-General of the World Trade Organisation, other family members, and the people of Ogwashi-Uku over the loss of their beloved mother, matriarch, and community leader.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/okon.summary_zh: 总统博拉·蒂努布向三角洲州奥格瓦希-乌库的奥孔乔王室成员致以诚挚慰问，以慰藉卡梅内·奥孔乔教授逝世之痛。她享年96岁。总统尤其向她的女儿、世界贸易组织总干事恩戈齐·奥孔乔-伊维拉博士，其他家庭成员以及奥格瓦希-乌库民众表示深切慰问，悼念他们挚爱的母亲、家族女家长和社区领袖的离世。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/okon.body: PRESIDENT Bola Tinubu has extended his heartfelt condolences to the Okonjo royal family of Ogwashi-Uku, Delta State, on the passing of Prof. Kamene Okonjo, who died at the age of 96. Prof. Okonjo was a distinguished scholar, a champion of women’s empowerment, and a revered matriarch. The President particularly commiserated with her daughter, Dr Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, Director-General of the World Trade Organisation, other family members, and the people of Ogwashi-Uku over the loss of their beloved mother, matriarch, and community leader. President Tinubu described Prof. Okonjo’s passing as the loss of an accomplished academic whose life was defined by intellectual distinction, service to humanity, and an enduring commitment to advancing women and society. He acknowledged her contributions to scholarship and her inspiring example as a woman who combined professional excellence with dedication to family, community, and the preservation of traditional institutions. The President prayed that Almighty God will grant the departed eternal rest and comfort the family and all who mourn her passing. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/okon.title_zh: 奥孔乔-伊维拉母亲去世，蒂努布表示哀悼
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/okon.body_zh: 总统博拉·蒂努布向三角洲州奥格瓦希-乌库的奥孔乔王族致以诚挚慰问，祝愿他们在卡梅内·奥孔乔教授逝世后节哀。奥孔乔教授享年96岁，是一位杰出的学者、妇女赋权的倡导者和备受尊敬的女家长。总统尤其慰问了她的女儿、世界贸易组织总干事恩戈齐·奥孔乔-伊韦拉博士，以及奥孔乔教授的其他家人和奥格瓦希-乌库民众，安慰他们失去挚爱的母亲、女家长和社区领袖。蒂努布总统表示，奥孔乔教授的逝世意味着一位成就卓著的学者离世，她的一生以卓越学识、服务人类以及推动妇女和社会发展的坚定 commitment 而熠熠生辉。总统肯定了她对学术研究的贡献，并赞扬她以女性身份将专业上的卓越成就与对家庭、社区及传统机构保护的奉献相结合，树立了鼓舞人心的榜样。总统祈祷全能的上帝赐予逝者永恒安息，并慰问其家人及所有哀悼她逝世的人。此处发表的评论并不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://leadership.ng/seven-2026-suvs-wo.title: Seven 2026 SUVs Worth ₦1.12bn: Inside APC’s Lavish Campaign Spending As Hardship Hits Nigerians Harder
https://leadership.ng/seven-2026-suvs-wo.summary: “At a time when millions of Nigerians are battling hunger, unemployment and rising living costs, the APC is preparing for 2027 with seven luxury SUVs worth an estimated ₦1.12 billion. Nigerian youths need jobs, opportunities and economic relief, not just political mobilisation ahead of elections.” “The question Nigerians should be asking is what seven Prados worth an estimated ₦1.12 billion will achieve beyond electoral mobilisation.
https://leadership.ng/seven-2026-suvs-wo.summary_zh: “在数百万尼日利亚人正与饥饿、失业和生活成本上涨作斗争之际，执政党 APC 正为2027年选举做准备，其配备的七辆豪华 SUV  estimated 总价值达₦1.12 billion。尼日利亚青年需要的是就业、机会和经济减负，而不只是选举前的政治动员。”“尼日利亚人应该思考的问题是，七辆总价值估计达₦1.12 billion的 Prado 除了推动选举动员之外，还能带来什么。
https://leadership.ng/seven-2026-suvs-wo.body: The party’s National Youth Leader, Dayo Israel, announced the presentation in a statement via X, expressing gratitude to First Lady Oluremi Tinubu for her continued support for the party’s youth structure. “Today, I presented a brand new 2026 Prado to my committed selected youth leaders to aid their election mobilisation activities,” Israel wrote. He added that the party’s supremacy would be demonstrated through its actions during the election period, declaring that the APC would deliver “polling unit by polling unit”. The announcement may appear to be a straightforward account of a political party equipping its operatives for an election campaign. But in a country where young people are contending with high living costs, limited economic opportunities and the difficulties of establishing independent livelihoods, the distribution raises broader questions about political priorities, youth empowerment and the meaning of the government’s promise of renewed hope. How much are the vehicles worth? Who financed their acquisition? What tangible benefits will the exercise deliver to young Nigerians outside the party’s political structure? And should a party seeking another mandate be judged only by its capacity to mobilise voters or also by how effectively its policies improve their lives? These questions deserve attention as the 2027 election approaches. LEADERSHIP reports that the Toyota Land Cruiser Prado is a premium sport utility vehicle designed for both urban driving and demanding terrain. Its features include a powerful turbocharged engine, a spacious cabin, advanced driving assistance systems and off-road technologies. According to the Nigerian website of Toyota’s authorised distributor, CFAO Mobility, the 2.4-litre turbo-petrol Adventure version of the Land Cruiser Prado is listed at ₦160 million. In comparison, the Premium version is listed at ₦190 million. Prices may vary depending on the model and specifications. Using the listed Adventure price as a benchmark, seven vehicles would cost approximately ₦1.12 billion. If all seven were Premium versions at the listed price, the total would rise to ₦1.33 billion. The actual cost of the vehicles presented by Israel has not been independently established, and the available information does not identify their exact specifications. The figures are therefore estimates based on advertised Nigerian prices, not a verified invoice for the vehicles. Nevertheless, the estimates indicate the financial scale of the presentation. Using the Central Bank of Nigeria’s reported foreign exchange rate of approximately ₦1,329.51 to the dollar on September 25, 2026, the ₦160 million Adventure price translates to about $120,345 per vehicle. Seven would amount to approximately $842,415. At the Premium price of ₦190 million, each vehicle would be worth about $142,910, bringing the total to approximately $1 million. These dollar equivalents are calculated from Nigerian retail prices. They are not US-market sticker prices, nor do they establish the amount actually paid by whoever provided the vehicles. The distinction matters. The available announcement does not establish whether the vehicles were purchased by the APC, donated by a private individual, financed by the First Lady or acquired through another arrangement. What is clear is that the presentation was explicitly linked to election mobilisation. That makes the intended use of the vehicles, the source of their funding and the results expected from the investment legitimate questions for the party’s leadership. The debate is not necessarily about whether political parties should provide their officials with vehicles. Campaign organisations require transport to coordinate meetings, reach communities and organise activities across geographical areas. The question is whether a mobilisation investment of this scale is accompanied by a similarly ambitious commitment to addressing the economic difficulties confronting young Nigerians. At the estimated cost of ₦1.12 billion, the seven vehicles represent a substantial amount of money that could also support other interventions, depending on their design and implementation. For instance, the sum could provide 11,200 grants of ₦100,000 each to young people seeking to establish small businesses. It could also finance 1,120 grants of ₦1 million each for beneficiaries with more capital-intensive business proposals. Alternatively, at the national minimum wage benchmark of ₦70,000 per month, ₦1.12 billion is equivalent to 16,000 monthly wage payments. Still, the comparisons help put the scale of the vehicle presentation into perspective. For a young Nigerian graduate struggling to secure a job, a young entrepreneur unable to obtain affordable credit or a skilled worker attempting to build a business from limited savings, the question is straightforward: what comparable opportunities are being created for them? The seven vehicles may improve the mobility of their recipients. Still, they do not, by themselves, create jobs, provide vocational training or make business financing more accessible to young people outside the party’s political structure. The responsibility for providing those opportunities rests on a wider set of institutions, including government agencies, financial institutions and private-sector employers. Yet the APC is not an ordinary political organisation. It is the governing party, and its youth leadership is closely associated with the political project of President Tinubu’s administration. Consequently, the party’s approach to youth mobilisation inevitably invites scrutiny of how its political priorities relate to the economic realities facing the population it seeks to represent. “At a time when millions of Nigerians are battling hunger, unemployment and rising living costs, the APC is preparing for 2027 with seven luxury SUVs worth an estimated ₦1.12 billion. This raises serious questions about the party’s priorities. Nigerian youths need jobs, opportunities and economic relief, not just political mobilisation ahead of elections.” “The question Nigerians should be asking is what seven Prados worth an estimated ₦1.12 billion will achieve beyond electoral mobilisation. That amount could support meaningful youth empowerment initiatives if properly invested. Political parties have a right to organise for elections, but the contrast between luxury campaign spending and the economic hardship facing ordinary Nigerians deserves serious scrutiny.” A Reuters report published in August 2026 highlighted the continuing cost-of-living difficulties facing Nigerians despite signs of improving investor confidence. The report cited World Bank estimates indicating that more than half of Nigerians lived in poverty in 2025, compared with about 42 per cent in 2022. Reacting to this development, Nigerians on X expressed their thoughts on the APC’s decision. “For context, @dayoisrael is the youth leader of Nigeria’s ruling APC, the same party whose president, Tinubu, is asking Nigerians to endure more suffering. When a party’s youth leader can donate multiple Prados to party loyalists, you begin to understand why more Nigerians are turning against Tinubu and the APC. If it’s not the First Lady dipping into what is possibly Nigeria’s commonwealth to distribute billions in gifts, it’s the President’s son flaunting billions. Now, the party’s youth leader is joining the spectacle, practically telling ordinary Nigerians to eff off! While Nigerians struggle to survive, the ruling elite compete to flaunt the most wealth. And they wonder why Nigerians are fed up?” “Yesterday, Tinubu claimed that his opponent plunged millions of citizens into untold HARDSHIP, HUNGER & INSECURITY. His wife and her favourite slave are sharing the latest Prado Jeeps amongst their gangs. Dayo flies private jets ALWAYS. The ancient druggie is so heartless!” “These are the issues. Remi Tinubu asked our mothers and us to go and be frying Ankara, roasted corn and kulikuli, but APC National Youth Leader, Dayo Israel, presented a brand-new 2026 Prado SUV to APC youth leaders for election mobilisation activities. Meanwhile, men of the Nigerian Army are eating bread with natural green (algae) tea. Meanwhile, ambulances 🚑 no dey hospitals in Nigeria in 2026. BUT PRADOS details for political jobbers! If you 🫵 DON’T end APC, APC WILL END YOU📌 Vote 🗳️ Obi-Kwankwaso, OK ✌2027, and put an end to these demonic rascalities and criminality” “You’re a disgrace, Dayo Israel. For one moment, I thought these were ambulances for FMC, Abeokuta. What is this?” We’ve got the edge. Get real-time reports, breaking scoops, and exclusive angles delivered straight to your phone. https://leadership.ng/seven-2026-suvs-wo.title_zh: 7辆价值11.2亿奈拉的运动型多用途车：随着生活困苦加剧尼日利亚人处境恶化，执政党奢侈竞选开销内幕
https://leadership.ng/seven-2026-suvs-wo.body_zh: 该党全国青年领袖达约·以色列通过X发布声宣布了车辆发放一事，并感谢第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布继续支持该党青年组织。以色列写道：“今天，我向坚定承诺履职的青年领袖发放了全新的2026款普拉多，以协助他们开展选举动员活动。”他补充称，该党将在选举期间通过行动证明自身的优势，并宣称全 progresses大会党（APC）将“一个投票站一个投票站地”取得成果。这项宣布看似只是政党为选举竞选装备工作人员的例行说明。然而，在年轻人正面临高生活成本、有限经济机会以及独立谋生困难的国度，这一发放行动引出了有关政治优先事项、青年赋权和政府“重燃希望”承诺之含义的更广泛问题。这些车辆价值多少？购置资金由谁提供？这项行动将给党外年轻尼日利亚人带来哪些切实益处？寻求再次执政授权的政党，是否应仅以其动员选民的能力接受评判，还是也应看其政策在多大程度上改善了选民的生活？随着2027年选举临近，这些问题值得关注。LEADERSHIP报道称，丰田兰德酷路泽普拉多是一款高端运动型多用途车，既适合城市驾驶，也能应对严苛地形。其特点包括动力强劲的涡轮增压发动机、宽敞座舱、先进驾驶辅助系统和越野技术。据丰田授权经销商CFAO Mobility的尼日利亚网站介绍，陆兰德酷路泽普拉多2.4升涡轮增压汽油Adventure版标价为₦1.6亿。相比之下，Premium版标价为₦1.9亿。价格可能因车型和配置而异。以所列Adventure版价格作为基准，7辆车总成本约为₦11.2亿。如果7辆全是按标价出售的Premium版，总额将升至₦13.3亿。以色列发放车辆的实际成本尚未得到独立确认，现有信息也未说明其具体配置。因此，这些数字只是依据尼日利亚广告价格作出的估算，并非车辆发票或经核实的价格。不过，估算数字体现了此次发放的财务规模。按尼日利亚中央银行公布的2026年9月25日约₦1,329.51兑1美元汇率计算，₦1.6亿一辆的Adventure版约合120,345美元。7辆约为842,415美元。按₦1.9亿的Premium版价格计算，每辆车约合142,910美元，总额约为100万美元。这些美元等值均根据尼日利亚零售价格计算，既不是美国市场的标价，也不能确定实际提供车辆者究竟支付了多少。两者之间的区别至关重要。现有公告没有说明车辆是由APC购买、由私人个人捐赠、由第一夫人出资，还是通过其他安排取得。可以明确的是，此次发放与选举动员有明确关联。因此，车辆预期用途、资金来源以及投资者希望取得何种成果，都是该党领导层理应回答的正当问题。这场争议未必是要讨论政党是否应该向工作人员提供车辆。竞选机构确实需要交通工具来协调会议、深入社区以及跨地区组织活动。问题在于，如此规模的动员投入，是否伴随着同等雄心的承诺，以解决年轻尼日利亚人面临的经济困难。按估算成本₦11.2亿计算，这7辆车代表着巨额资金；视具体设计和实施方式而定，这笔钱原本也可以用于支持其他干预措施。例如，这笔资金可以向希望创办小企业的年轻人提供11,200笔每笔₦100,000的补助；也可以为资本需求更高的商业计划受益人提供1,120笔每笔₦100万的补助。或者，按每月₦70,000的全国最低工资基准计算，₦11.2亿相当于发放16,000个月的工资。尽管如此，这些比较有助于直观呈现车辆发放行动的规模。对一位苦于找不到工作的年轻尼日利亚毕业生、一位无法获得可负担信贷的年轻创业者，或是一位试图用有限积蓄创业的熟练工人而言，问题都很直接：政府正在为他们创造哪些同等机会？这7辆车或许能改善受赠者的机动性，却不能单独创造就业、提供职业培训，或让党外年轻人更容易获得商业融资。提供这些机会的责任由更广泛的机构共同承担，包括政府机构、金融机构和私营部门雇主。然而，APC并非普通政治组织。它是执政党，其青年领导层与蒂努布总统政府的政治计划密切相关。因此，该党开展青年动员的方式 inevitably 会引发审视：其政治优先事项与其所代表人口所面临的经济现实之间究竟有何关系。“在数百万尼日利亚人正与饥饿、失业和生活成本上涨作斗争之际，APC正用7辆估计价值₦11.2亿的豪华SUV为2027年选举做准备。这对该党的优先事项提出了严肃问题。尼日利亚年轻人需要工作、机会和经济减负，而不只是选举前的政治动员。”“尼日利亚人应该问的问题是，7辆估计价值₦11.2亿的普拉多，除了选举动员之外还能带来什么？如果得到妥善投资，这笔钱可以支持意义重大的青年赋权项目。政党有权为选举组织活动，但豪华竞选开支与普通尼日利亚人所面临的经济困境之间的反差，值得严肃审视。”路透社2026年8月发布的一份报道凸显，尽管投资者信心出现改善迹象，尼日利亚人的生活成本困难仍在持续。报道援引世界银行估计称，2025年超过一半尼日利亚人生活在贫困之中，而2022年这一比例约为42%。对此，尼日利亚人在X上表达了对APC这一决定的想法。“提供一点背景：@dayoisrael是尼日利亚执政党APC的青年领袖；该党总统蒂努布正要求尼日利亚人忍受更多苦难。当一个政党的青年领袖可以向党内忠实支持者捐赠多辆普拉多时，你就开始明白为什么越来越多尼日利亚人正在反对蒂努布和APC了。如果不是第一夫人动用可能是尼日利亚共有财产的财富来发放数十亿礼物，那就是总统的儿子在炫耀数十亿财富。如今，该党青年领袖也加入了这场排场，实际上是在告诉普通尼日利亚人滚开！当尼日利亚人还在为生存挣扎时，统治精英却争相炫耀最奢华的财富。他们还纳闷尼日利亚人为何忍无可忍？”“昨天，蒂努布声称他的对手让数百万国民陷入难以言说的艰难、饥饿与不安全之中。他的妻子和她最喜欢的奴才正在给他们那帮人的手下分发最新款普拉多吉普。达约总是乘坐私人飞机。这个老瘾君子真是冷酷无情！”“这就是问题所在。雷米·蒂努布让我们的母亲和我们去炸Ankara、烤玉米和炸kulikuli，但APC全国青年领袖达约·以色列却向APC青年领袖发放了全新的2026款普拉多SUV，用于选举动员活动。与此同时，尼日利亚陆军士兵靠面包和天然绿色藻茶果腹。与此同时，2026年尼日利亚的医院连救护车🚑都没有。但给政治掮客配备普拉多细节却一应俱全！如果你🫵不让APC下台，APC就会让你下台📌2027年投🗳️奥比-夸恩瓦索一票，没问题✌，终结这些邪恶勾当和犯罪行为。”“你真让人失望，达约·以色列。有那么一瞬间，我还以为这些是阿贝奥库塔联邦医学中心（FMC）的救护车。这算什么？”我们掌握前沿动态。实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角将直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sold.title: Soldiers earn peanuts, APC youth leader flaunts billion-naira SUVs
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sold.summary: Professor Pat Utomi has criticised the All Progressives Congress (APC) over the distribution of luxury sport utility vehicles (SUVs) to selected youth leaders, contrasting the expenditure with what he described as poor salaries paid to Nigerian soldiers. Utomi, a chieftain of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), said it was troubling that an APC youth leader could display expensive vehicles at a time Nigerians had been told that government funds were limited.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sold.summary_zh: Pat Utomi教授批评全进步大会党（APC）向部分青年领袖发放豪华运动型多用途车（SUV），并将这项支出与他所称的尼日利亚军人薪酬低下作对比。身为尼日利亚民主党（NDC）派别领袖的Utomi表示，在政府一直被告知资金有限的情况下，APC青年领袖却能展示昂贵车辆，这令人不安。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sold.body: Professor Pat Utomi has criticised the All Progressives Congress (APC) over the distribution of luxury sport utility vehicles (SUVs) to selected youth leaders, contrasting the expenditure with what he described as poor salaries paid to Nigerian soldiers. Utomi, a chieftain of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), said it was troubling that an APC youth leader could display expensive vehicles at a time Nigerians had been told that government funds were limited. In a post on X on Sunday, Utomi wrote: “Nigerian soldiers are being paid peanuts as salaries, yet an APC youth leader is flaunting SUVs worth billions of naira. This is the same government that told Nigerians there was no longer money in the treasury. At this point, they must think we are fools!” In another post, the professor questioned whether the money spent on the vehicles could have been put to better use, particularly in the health sector. “Each of the SUVs in this video costs more than ₦100 million. I wonder how many world-class ambulances the millions being spent on these vehicles could buy. What a pity!” he wrote. The comments followed a video posted by APC National Youth Leader, Dayo Israel, showing brand-new 2026 Toyota Prado SUVs he said were presented to selected youth leaders to support election mobilisation ahead of the 2027 general elections. “Today, I presented brand new 2026 Prado to my committed selected youth leaders to aid their election mobilisation activities,” Israel wrote. He also expressed gratitude to First Lady Oluremi Tinubu for what he described as her continued support for the party’s structure under his leadership. “The party is supreme and that supremacy will show in our action in this election period — we will deliver polling unit by polling unit,” he added. The video, which has since been deleted, drew criticism from Nigerians on social media, with some questioning the timing of the vehicle distribution amid the economic hardship associated with the Tinubu administration’s reforms. Utomi’s remarks add to the criticism surrounding the display, with the NDC chieftain raising questions about public spending priorities and the cost of the vehicles. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sold.title_zh: 士兵收入仅够糊口，全民进步大会党青年领袖却炫耀价值数十亿奈拉的运动型多用途车
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sold.body_zh: 帕特·乌托米教授批评全进步大会党（APC）向部分青年领袖发放豪华运动型多用途车（SUV），并将这项支出与尼日利亚士兵薪资微薄的情况作对比。乌托米是尼日利亚民主大会党（NDC）的党内要员。他表示，令人担忧的是，在政府资金有限的情况下，APC青年领袖竟能炫耀昂贵车辆。周日，他在X上发帖写道：“尼日利亚士兵领到的薪水少得可怜，但APC青年领袖却炫示价值数十亿奈拉的运动型多用途车。这正是曾告诉尼日利亚人国库里已无资金的同一个政府。事到如今，他们肯定以为我们都是傻瓜！”在另一条帖子中，这位教授质疑花在这些车辆上的钱是否可以得到更好的用途，尤其是在医疗卫生领域。他写道：“这段视频中的每辆运动型多用途车都价值超过1亿奈拉。我真想知道，花在这些车上的数百万资金能买多少辆世界一流的救护车。太可惜了！”这些评论出现在APC全国青年领袖达约·以色列发布的一段视频之后。视频展示了崭新的2026款丰田普拉多运动型多用途车，他称这些车辆是为支持部分青年领袖而在2027年大选前开展选举动员而发放的。以色列写道：“今天，我向忠诚且经过筛选的青年领袖发放了崭新的2026款普拉多，以协助他们开展选举动员活动。”他还感谢第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布，并称在自己领导下，她继续支持该党的组织建设。他补充道：“党高于一切，而这种至高地位将在我们此次选举时期的行动中得到体现——我们将逐个投票站落实。”这段视频此后已被删除，却招致尼日利亚网民在社交媒体上的批评。一些人质疑，在蒂努布政府推行改革并引发经济困境之际发放车辆的时机是否恰当。乌托米的言论进一步加剧了外界对这场车辆展示的批评，这位尼日利亚民主大会党党内要员就公共支出优先事项和车辆成本提出疑问。此处发表的评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://leadership.ng/police-corporal-al.title: Police Corporal Allegedly Kills Female Colleague, Commits Suicide In Kogi
https://leadership.ng/police-corporal-al.summary: The incident, which occurred on October 23, 2026, involved Corporal Amos Yusuf and Woman Corporal Grace Onimisi, both serving officers of the Nigeria Police Force. The Kogi State Police Command confirmed the incident in a statement issued on Sunday by its Police Public Relations Officer, ASP Saliu Oyiza Afusat. The Commissioner of Police in Kogi State, CP Naziru Bello Kankarofi, expressed condolences to the families, colleagues and loved ones of the deceased officers.

However, a LEADERSHIP investigation revealed that the officers were reportedly in a romantic relationship that had recently broken down. Sources familiar with the incident alleged that Yusuf was angered by Onimisi’s decision to end the relationship before the shooting. The police said both officers were rushed to separate medical facilities, where medical personnel confirmed their deaths. Their remains were subsequently deposited at the mortuary of ASCO Hospital. An AK-47 rifle and four expended cartridges were recovered at the scene as exhibits, according to the command. The police disclosed that the case had been transferred to the State Criminal Investigation Department for an in-depth investigation, adding that the circumstances surrounding the incident and the motive remained under investigation. The Commissioner of Police in Kogi State, CP Naziru Bello Kankarofi, expressed condolences to the families, colleagues and loved ones of the deceased officers.
